deeplink_note: The Inspectie's own external-link route. BRIN4 = first four characters of the school id; SECTOR = PO for schools_po (incl. sbo), SO for schools_so, VO for schools_vo. Opens the search results for that BRIN (all its locations; a PO BRIN is usually one school). Tested for 00AR PO, 00AH VO and 06SV SO. /zoek?q={BRIN4} also works; a BRIN6 query returns nothing. There is no per-school or per-report URL without the site's API (not used: no stated licence).
